blocks.zh: Learning Objectives | 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 學完本節後，你將能夠：
blocks.en: After completing this section, you will be able to:

blocks.zh: 說明水為何是製藥生產中最關鍵的公用物料
blocks.en: Explain why water is the most critical utility material in pharmaceutical manufacturing

blocks.zh: 區別 PW、HPW、WFI 的規格、用途與各藥典（USP、EP、JP）的法規依據
blocks.en: Distinguish PW, HPW and WFI in terms of specification, use and regulatory basis in the pharmacopoeias (USP, EP, JP)

blocks.zh: 分辨均質雜質與非均質雜質的分佈差異及其對取樣策略的影響
blocks.en: Differentiate the distribution of homogeneous and heterogeneous impurities and explain the impact on sampling strategy

blocks.zh: 描述取樣目的的五大類別，並將每類與適當的取樣頻率和位置對應
blocks.en: Describe the five categories of sampling purpose and match each to an appropriate sampling frequency and location

blocks.zh: 以統計定義警戒水準（2σ）和行動水準（3σ），並描述升級回應程序
blocks.en: Define the Alert Level (2σ) and Action Level (3σ) statistically and describe the escalation response procedure

blocks.zh: 在配水迴路中運用風險評估方法選擇取樣位置
blocks.en: Apply a risk assessment approach to select sampling locations in a distribution loop

blocks.zh: 識別水系統中的微生物熱點（死腿、閥座、軟管）
blocks.en: Identify microbial hot spots in a water system (deadlegs, valve seats, hoses)

blocks.zh: 解釋 POU 的製程控制取樣與品質控制取樣之差異
blocks.en: Explain the difference between process control sampling and quality control sampling at the POU

blocks.zh: Introduction | 簡介
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: Water as the most widely used pharmaceutical material — roles and sampling fundamentals | 水作為最廣泛使用的製藥物料
blocks.en: Water as the most widely used pharmaceutical material — roles and sampling fundamentals

blocks.zh: 中文解析與 CDMO 應用 | Commentary & CDMO Context
blocks.en: Commentary & CDMO Context

blocks.zh: 水的五種角色
blocks.en: The five roles of water

blocks.zh: 水在製藥中同時扮演五種角色：產品原料、清洗劑、滅菌介質、分析試劑、製劑輔助劑。在 CDMO 環境中，同一條水迴路可能在同一天用於多個客戶產品的配製與清洗，因此水質監控失敗的影響是跨產品的。
blocks.en: Water plays five roles in pharmaceutical manufacturing at the same time: product ingredient, cleaning agent, sterilization medium, analytical reagent and formulation aid. In a CDMO environment, the same water loop may be used on the same day to prepare and clean for several clients' products, so a failure in water quality monitoring has cross-product impact.

blocks.zh: CQA 的定義
blocks.en: Definition of a CQA

blocks.zh: Critical Quality Attribute（關鍵品質屬性）是指對產品安全性、效力或品質有直接影響的物理、化學、生物或微生物特性。對於水系統而言，CQA 通常包括導電率、TOC、內毒素（WFI）和微生物含量。
blocks.en: A Critical Quality Attribute (CQA) is a physical, chemical, biological or microbiological property that directly affects the safety, efficacy or quality of the product. For a water system, the CQAs usually include conductivity, TOC, endotoxin (WFI) and microbial content.

blocks.zh: 比喻：水質像城市供水
blocks.en: Analogy: water quality is like a city water supply

blocks.zh: 想像一個城市的自來水系統：主幹管（storage tank → 配水迴路）代表整體水質，而每個水龍頭（POU）代表實際使用點。即使主幹管水質合格，末端水龍頭的橡膠墊圈或管內積水仍可能帶入微生物污染。這正是 ISPE 強調「取樣方式應模擬使用方式」的原因。
blocks.en: Think of a city's tap water system: the main pipeline (storage tank → distribution loop) represents overall water quality, and each faucet (POU) represents an actual point of use. Even when the main pipeline water is acceptable, the rubber washer in the end faucet or stagnant water in the pipe can still introduce microbial contamination. This is why ISPE stresses that "sampling should mimic the way the water is used".

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：多客戶水系統的挑戰
blocks.en: CDMO practice: the challenge of a multi-client water system

blocks.zh: 在多品種 CDMO 廠，PW 和 WFI 迴路服務不同客戶產品線。取樣策略必須考慮：
blocks.en: At a multi-product CDMO site, the PW and WFI loops serve the product lines of different clients. The sampling strategy must take into account:

blocks.zh: 不同客戶對水規格的個別要求（可能高於藥典）
blocks.en: Individual client requirements for water specifications (which may be stricter than the pharmacopoeia)

blocks.zh: 共用迴路的污染風險（清洗驗證 + 水質確認）
blocks.en: Contamination risk of the shared loop (cleaning validation + water quality confirmation)

blocks.zh: 高峰生產時多個 POU 同時使用，水壓和流速變化對微生物的影響
blocks.en: Several POUs in use at the same time during peak production, and the effect of changes in water pressure and flow velocity on microbial levels

blocks.zh: 法規重點：「以使用方式取樣」
blocks.en: Regulatory focus: "sample the way the water is used"

blocks.zh: FDA 1993 年檢查指南明確要求：水的取樣方式應盡可能複製製造時的使用方式。這意味著如果生產時會連接軟管和熱交換器，取樣時也應如此操作——否則取樣結果不具代表性，在偏差調查中將受到質疑。
blocks.en: The 1993 FDA inspection guide clearly requires that water be sampled in a way that replicates, as far as possible, how it is used in manufacturing. This means that if a hose and a heat exchanger are connected during production, the same must be done when sampling — otherwise the sampling result is not representative and will be challenged in a deviation investigation.

blocks.zh: Practice Questions | 練習思考
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: A CDMO site has a single WFI loop serving both aseptic fill-finish and lyophilizer loading. What are the primary CQAs you would monitor, and why is endotoxin particularly critical for this loop? （一條 WFI 迴路同時服務無菌灌裝和凍乾機裝料，主要 CQA 為何？為何內毒素特別關鍵？）
blocks.en: A CDMO site has a single WFI loop serving both aseptic fill-finish and lyophilizer loading. What are the primary CQAs you would monitor, and why is endotoxin particularly critical for this loop?

blocks.zh: The guide states that water sampled the same way as used in manufacturing is "the best indicator of quality going into a product." Why would an upstream sample port on a POU valve NOT satisfy this requirement for microbial testing? （為何 POU 閥上游的取樣埠無法滿足微生物取樣的代表性要求？）
blocks.en: The guide states that water sampled the same way as used in manufacturing is "the best indicator of quality going into a product." Why would an upstream sample port on a POU valve NOT satisfy this requirement for microbial testing?

blocks.zh: Your PW system serves a washer (non-parenteral), a formulation tank (oral), and a buffer prep vessel (injectable). Should they all use the same sampling protocol? Justify your answer. （三個不同用途的 POU 應使用相同取樣規程嗎？說明理由。）
blocks.en: Your PW system serves a washer (non-parenteral), a formulation tank (oral), and a buffer prep vessel (injectable). Should they all use the same sampling protocol? Justify your answer.

blocks.zh: Homogeneously Distributed Impurities | 均質分佈雜質
blocks.en: Homogeneously Distributed Impurities

blocks.zh: Chemical impurities, conductivity, TOC — same concentration throughout the loop | 化學雜質在整個迴路中均勻分佈
blocks.en: Chemical impurities, conductivity, TOC — same concentration throughout the loop

blocks.zh: 中文解析：均質 vs 非均質雜質的策略含義
blocks.en: Commentary: strategic implications of homogeneous vs. heterogeneous impurities

blocks.zh: 均質雜質（Homogeneous）
blocks.en: Homogeneous impurities

blocks.zh: 關鍵結論：導電率和 TOC 在迴路中濃度一致，因此可以用迴路回流口的在線儀表替代逐一 POU 手動取樣。這是製藥水系統中重要的連續監控合理性依據。但必須先通過取樣驗證，確認儀表位置的讀數確實代表所有 POU 的濃度。
blocks.en: Key conclusion: conductivity and TOC have the same concentration throughout the loop, so an in-line instrument at the loop return can replace manual sampling at each individual POU. This is the main rationale for continuous monitoring in pharmaceutical water systems. However, sampling must first be used to verify that the reading at the instrument location really represents the concentration at all POUs.

blocks.zh: 例外情況：子迴路污染
blocks.en: Exception: sub-loop contamination

blocks.zh: 如果某個子迴路（sub-loop）或 POU 下游有可能引入化學污染（如：軟管的塑化劑析出、橡膠墊圈的有機物溶出），則主迴路的在線儀表無法偵測到這些局部污染。必須在子迴路或 POU 處增加手動取樣或獨立儀表。
blocks.en: If chemical contamination could be introduced in a sub-loop or downstream of a POU (for example, plasticizer leaching from hoses or organics extracted from rubber gaskets), the in-line instrument on the main loop cannot detect such localized contamination. Manual sampling or a separate instrument must be added at the sub-loop or POU.

blocks.zh: 非均質雜質（Heterogeneous）— 生物膜的真相
blocks.en: Heterogeneous impurities — the truth about biofilm

blocks.zh: 系統中 99.9–99.99% 的細菌存在於生物膜（biofilm）中，附著在管壁、閥座等表面，而非懸浮在水中。取樣只能偵測到浮游（planktonic）細菌——僅佔系統總菌量的 0.01–0.1%。
blocks.en: 99.9–99.99% of the bacteria in a system live in biofilm, attached to surfaces such as pipe walls and valve seats, rather than suspended in the water. Sampling can detect only planktonic bacteria, which make up just 0.01–0.1% of the total bacterial population in the system.

blocks.zh: 實務含義：低菌計數不代表系統清潔；若生物膜在某次衝擊（溫度變化、流速突增）後脫落，計數可能突然飆升。這是為何警戒/行動水準和趨勢分析比單次結果更重要。
blocks.en: Practical implication: a low microbial count does not mean the system is clean; if biofilm sloughs off after an upset (a temperature change or a sudden increase in flow velocity), the count can suddenly spike. This is why alert/action levels and trend analysis matter more than any single result.

blocks.zh: CDMO 高風險場景：死腿與慢流區
blocks.en: High-risk CDMO scenario: deadlegs and low-flow zones

blocks.zh: 在設計複雜的多產品廠房中，管道佈局往往形成「臨時死腿」——例如長期不使用的 POU 支管、停用的設備連接管。ISPE 明確指出這些是生物膜熱點。CDMO 操作員必須：
blocks.en: In a complex multi-product facility, the piping layout often creates "temporary deadlegs", for example branch lines to POUs that have not been used for a long time and connection lines to decommissioned equipment. ISPE clearly identifies these as biofilm hot spots. CDMO operators must:

blocks.zh: 定期沖洗或封閉停用的 POU（lock out / tag out）
blocks.en: Flush or close off unused POUs regularly (lock out / tag out)

blocks.zh: 在恢復使用前執行微生物取樣確認
blocks.en: Perform microbial sampling to confirm quality before returning them to use

blocks.zh: 將死腿長度控制在 3D 以內（管徑的 3 倍，工業慣例）
blocks.en: Keep deadleg length within 3D (3 times the pipe diameter, an industry convention)

blocks.zh: 比喻：生物膜像淋浴蓮蓬頭的水垢
blocks.en: Analogy: biofilm is like limescale in a shower head

blocks.zh: 長期不使用的蓮蓬頭內部會積累生物膜（即俗稱的「水垢微生物」）。當你打開水龍頭的瞬間，大量細菌被沖出——這就是「過夜停滯（overnight stagnation）」對 WFI 系統的危害。製藥水系統的解決方案：保持循環流速、定期熱水消毒或週期性蒸汽滅菌。
blocks.en: The inside of a shower head that is not used for a long time accumulates biofilm (what is commonly called "scale bacteria"). The moment you turn on the tap, large numbers of bacteria are flushed out — this is the danger that "overnight stagnation" poses to a WFI system. The solution for pharmaceutical water systems: maintain circulation flow velocity and carry out regular hot water sanitization or periodic steam sterilization.

blocks.zh: Your WFI loop has 12 POUs. For conductivity monitoring, how many locations do you actually need to sample manually, assuming a validated in-line instrument is installed at the loop return? Justify your answer citing the principle of homogeneous distribution. （假設迴路回流口安裝了已驗證的在線導電率儀，手動取樣幾個位置就足夠？）
blocks.en: Your WFI loop has 12 POUs. For conductivity monitoring, how many locations do you actually need to sample manually, assuming a validated in-line instrument is installed at the loop return? Justify your answer citing the principle of homogeneous distribution.

blocks.zh: A QC analyst finds low bioburden (<1 cfu/100 mL) in a WFI loop for 6 consecutive months. Is it safe to conclude the system has no biofilm risk? Why or why not? （6個月連續低菌計數是否代表系統沒有生物膜風險？）
blocks.en: A QC analyst finds low bioburden (<1 cfu/100 mL) in a WFI loop for 6 consecutive months. Is it safe to conclude the system has no biofilm risk? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: Describe two engineering controls you would specify during detailed design to minimize deadleg formation in a WFI distribution loop serving 8 manufacturing suites. （描述兩種在詳細設計階段減少死腿形成的工程管控措施。）
blocks.en: Describe two engineering controls you would specify during detailed design to minimize deadleg formation in a WFI distribution loop serving 8 manufacturing suites.

blocks.zh: Purpose of Sampling | 取樣目的
blocks.en: Purpose of Sampling

blocks.zh: Five categories: regulatory, consensus standards, process control, quality control, investigative | 五類取樣目的
blocks.en: Five categories: regulatory, consensus standards, process control, quality control, investigative

blocks.zh: 中文解析：取樣目的的五大類別
blocks.en: Commentary: the five categories of sampling purpose

blocks.zh: 為什麼要在設計初期確認取樣目的？
blocks.en: Why confirm the sampling purpose early in design?

blocks.zh: ISPE 強調：取樣目的應在設計過程中盡早確認並記錄。這是因為取樣點的位置、閥種選擇、管道尺寸和人員可及性必須在 P&ID 和施工圖完成前決定。事後改造既昂貴又困難——這正是許多廠房取樣計畫不合理的根本原因。
blocks.en: ISPE stresses that the sampling purpose should be confirmed and documented as early as possible in the design process. This is because the location of sample points, the choice of valve type, the pipe size and the accessibility for personnel must be decided before the P&IDs and construction drawings are finished. Retrofitting later is expensive and difficult — this is the root cause of the unreasonable sampling plans at many facilities.

blocks.zh: FDA 1993 指南的行動限度仍是工業標準
blocks.en: The FDA 1993 guide's action limits remain the industry standard

blocks.zh: 雖然 USP、EP、JP 的藥典並未規定細菌計數限度，但 FDA 1993 年高純度水檢查指南所訂的限度（PW ≤100 cfu/mL，WFI ≤10 cfu/100 mL）已成為全球製藥廠實際執行的事實標準。在偏差調查和法規審查中，這些數字是基準線。
blocks.en: Although the USP, EP and JP pharmacopoeias do not specify bacterial count limits, the limits set in the 1993 FDA high purity water inspection guide (PW ≤100 cfu/mL, WFI ≤10 cfu/100 mL) have become the de facto standard that pharmaceutical plants worldwide actually apply. In deviation investigations and regulatory reviews, these numbers are the baseline.

blocks.zh: 警戒/行動水準的統計設定實務
blocks.en: Practice for statistically setting alert/action levels

blocks.zh: 設定警戒（Alert）和行動（Action）水準的正確做法：
blocks.en: The correct way to set Alert and Action levels:

blocks.zh: 收集至少 3–6 個月的歷史穩態數據
blocks.en: Collect at least 3–6 months of historical steady-state data

blocks.zh: 計算均值（μ）和標準差（σ）
blocks.en: Calculate the mean (μ) and standard deviation (σ)

blocks.zh: 警戒水準 = μ + 2σ；行動水準 = μ + 3σ
blocks.en: Alert Level = μ + 2σ; Action Level = μ + 3σ

blocks.zh: 確保行動水準低於藥典規格（留有緩衝空間）
blocks.en: Make sure the Action Level is below the pharmacopoeial specification (leaving a buffer)

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤：將行動水準直接設在藥典規格，沒有緩衝。這樣的設定使系統沒有早期預警的機會。
blocks.en: Common mistake: setting the Action Level directly at the pharmacopoeial specification, with no buffer. Such a setting leaves the system with no opportunity for early warning.

blocks.zh: 比喻：警戒/行動水準像汽車儀表板
blocks.en: Analogy: alert/action levels are like a car dashboard

blocks.zh:
警戒水準（Alert）= 油量警示燈亮起（還有油，但需要注意）
行動水準（Action）= 緊急警告音（需要立即加油）
規格限度（OOS）= 拋錨（已造成問題）
好的系統設計讓你在「拋錨」之前有足夠時間反應。
blocks.en:
Alert Level = fuel warning light comes on (there is still fuel, but pay attention)
Action Level = urgent warning sound (refuel immediately)
Specification limit (OOS) = breakdown (the problem has already occurred)
A good system design gives you enough time to react before the "breakdown".

blocks.zh: CDMO 多客戶場景：警戒水準的挑戰
blocks.en: CDMO multi-client scenario: the challenge of alert levels

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，同一條水迴路服務不同客戶，但各客戶可能要求不同的警戒/行動水準（部分跨國製藥公司的內部標準比藥典更嚴格）。建議做法：在 CDMO 層級設定最嚴格的統一標準，並在客戶合約中明確記錄合規依據。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, the same water loop serves different clients, but each client may require different alert/action levels (the internal standards of some multinational pharmaceutical companies are stricter than the pharmacopoeia). Recommended approach: set the strictest common standard at the CDMO level and clearly document the compliance basis in the client contracts.

blocks.zh: A water system has historical WFI bioburden data with mean 0.5 cfu/100 mL and standard deviation 1.2 cfu/100 mL. Calculate the Alert Level (2σ) and Action Level (3σ). Are these below the FDA 10 cfu/100 mL action limit? （計算警戒和行動水準，並確認是否低於 FDA 限度。）
blocks.en: A water system has historical WFI bioburden data with mean 0.5 cfu/100 mL and standard deviation 1.2 cfu/100 mL. Calculate the Alert Level (2σ) and Action Level (3σ). Are these below the FDA 10 cfu/100 mL action limit?

blocks.zh: Alert Level excursions occur at three POUs on the same day, all in the same sub-loop. What does the guide say about concurrent excursions at multiple locations? What is the appropriate next step? （同一子迴路三個 POU 同日超出警戒，下一步應如何？）
blocks.en: Alert Level excursions occur at three POUs on the same day, all in the same sub-loop. What does the guide say about concurrent excursions at multiple locations? What is the appropriate next step?

blocks.zh: Explain why it is inappropriate to monitor conductivity and hardness at the same sampling point (e.g., after a carbon bed). Use the process control purpose rationale. （為何在碳床後同時監測導電率和硬度是不恰當的？）
blocks.en: Explain why it is inappropriate to monitor conductivity and hardness at the same sampling point (e.g., after a carbon bed). Use the process control purpose rationale.

blocks.zh: 2.1.2.4–2.1.2.5: Quality Control & Investigative Sampling | 品質控制與調查取樣
blocks.en: 2.1.2.4–2.1.2.5: Quality Control & Investigative Sampling

blocks.zh: Duplicating manufacturing conditions; OOS investigations; diagnostic sampling | 複製製造條件；OOS 調查；診斷取樣
blocks.en: Duplicating manufacturing conditions; OOS investigations; diagnostic sampling

blocks.zh: 中文解析：品質控制取樣的嚴格要求
blocks.en: Commentary: strict requirements for quality control sampling

blocks.zh: QC 取樣：「模擬製造」的核心要求
blocks.en: QC sampling: the core requirement of "simulating manufacturing"

blocks.zh: 品質控制取樣的本質是複製製造行為。這意味著：
blocks.en: The essence of quality control sampling is to replicate manufacturing practice. This means:

blocks.zh: 用相同的軟管和墊圈
blocks.en: Use the same hoses and gaskets

blocks.zh: 執行相同的出水口消毒程序
blocks.en: Perform the same outlet sanitization procedure

blocks.zh: 保留相同的下游設備（熱交換器、流量計）
blocks.en: Keep the same downstream equipment (heat exchangers, flow meters)

blocks.zh: 在製造開始前取樣（而非取樣後才安裝設備）
blocks.en: Sample before manufacturing starts (not install the equipment after sampling)

blocks.zh: 直接影響：取樣結果代表的是「進入產品的水質」，而非「迴路中的水質」。
blocks.en: Direct impact: the sampling result represents "the quality of the water going into the product", not "the quality of the water in the loop".

blocks.zh: POU 上游取樣埠：QC 取樣的陷阱
blocks.en: Upstream POU sample ports: a trap for QC sampling

blocks.zh: 許多廠房為了方便，在 POU 閥的上游安裝取樣埠。這對製程控制（PC）取樣是可接受的，但對品質控制（QC）取樣通常不合格——因為上游取樣埠繞過了閥座、軟管、熱交換器等微生物熱點，無法代表實際進入產品的水質。
blocks.en: For convenience, many facilities install sample ports upstream of the POU valve. This is acceptable for process control (PC) sampling but is generally not acceptable for quality control (QC) sampling, because an upstream sample port bypasses the valve seat, hose, heat exchanger and other microbial hot spots and cannot represent the quality of the water actually going into the product.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：硬接管製造設備的取樣挑戰
blocks.en: CDMO practice: the challenge of sampling hard-piped manufacturing equipment

blocks.zh: 現代無菌灌裝設備通常直接硬接管到 WFI 系統，無法拆卸取樣。ISPE 建議的解決方案：
blocks.en: Modern aseptic filling equipment is usually hard-piped directly to the WFI system and cannot be disconnected for sampling. Solutions recommended by ISPE:

blocks.zh: 三通轉向閥（three-way divert valve）：在設備入口安裝，允許水流轉向至取樣容器
blocks.en: Three-way divert valve: installed at the equipment inlet, allowing the water flow to be diverted to a sample container

blocks.zh: 設備隔離閥旁邊的取樣埠：在水首次流入製造槽時取樣
blocks.en: Sample port next to the equipment isolation valve: sample when water first flows into the manufacturing vessel

blocks.zh: 直接斷開管道（若可行）：將水流引向取樣容器代替流入設備
blocks.en: Direct disconnection of the piping (where feasible): direct the water flow to a sample container instead of into the equipment

blocks.zh: 這些工程解決方案應在廠房設計階段就規劃，而非在驗證時才發現問題。
blocks.en: These engineering solutions should be planned during facility design, rather than discovering the problem during validation.

blocks.zh: 比喻：調查取樣像犯罪現場鑑識
blocks.en: Analogy: investigative sampling is like crime scene forensics

blocks.zh: 當常規監控發現異常（如某一 POU 突然出現高菌計數），調查取樣就像犯罪現場鑑識：在問題附近增加取樣點，逐步縮小範圍，找出污染源（可能是某個閥座損壞、某段管道形成死腿）。調查取樣的數據通常不用於常規放行，而是用於根本原因分析。
blocks.en: When routine monitoring finds an abnormality (for example, a sudden high microbial count at one POU), investigative sampling works like crime scene forensics: add sample points near the problem and narrow the scope step by step to find the source of contamination (perhaps a damaged valve seat or a section of piping that has formed a deadleg). Data from investigative sampling are normally not used for routine release but for root cause analysis.

blocks.zh: A QC technician collects a WFI sample from the upstream port of a POU diaphragm valve (before the hose and heat exchanger). Bioburden result: 0 cfu/100 mL. Can this result be used to release the batch? Why or why not? （從 POU 閥上游取樣的微生物結果可以用於批次放行嗎？）
blocks.en: A QC technician collects a WFI sample from the upstream port of a POU diaphragm valve (before the hose and heat exchanger). Bioburden result: 0 cfu/100 mL. Can this result be used to release the batch? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: An OOS WFI result (25 cfu/100 mL) is obtained from a fill-finish room POU. The QC manager wants to resample immediately. What should happen before resampling, according to this guide's OOS investigation framework? （在重新取樣之前，根據 ISPE 的 OOS 調查框架應先做什麼？）
blocks.en: An OOS WFI result (25 cfu/100 mL) is obtained from a fill-finish room POU. The QC manager wants to resample immediately. What should happen before resampling, according to this guide's OOS investigation framework?

blocks.zh: Your CDMO site is launching a new injectable product with a dedicated formulation room. The WFI drop to the formulation vessel is permanently piped. Describe the sampling strategy you would implement, specifying valve type and sampling procedure. （為新的注射劑配製室設計 WFI 取樣策略，說明閥型和取樣程序。）
blocks.en: Your CDMO site is launching a new injectable product with a dedicated formulation room. The WFI drop to the formulation vessel is permanently piped. Describe the sampling strategy you would implement, specifying valve type and sampling procedure.

blocks.zh: 2.2 Determining Sampling Locations | 確定取樣位置
blocks.en: 2.2 Determining Sampling Locations

blocks.zh: Risk-based approach; loop geometry; critical points; microbiological hot spots | 風險評估；迴路幾何；關鍵點；微生物熱點
blocks.en: Risk-based approach; loop geometry; critical points; microbiological hot spots

blocks.zh: 中文解析：取樣位置選擇的風險評估方法
blocks.en: Commentary: a risk assessment approach to selecting sampling locations

blocks.zh: 風險分析（RA）在取樣點選擇中的角色
blocks.en: The role of risk analysis (RA) in selecting sample points

blocks.zh: ISPE 建議在廠房設計的概念階段（Conceptual Design）就進行取樣位置的風險分析。RA 應回答以下問題：
blocks.en: ISPE recommends carrying out a risk analysis of sampling locations as early as the Conceptual Design phase of facility design. The RA should answer the following questions:

blocks.zh: 哪些位置的水質失控會直接影響產品 CQA？（優先取樣）
blocks.en: At which locations would a loss of water quality control directly affect product CQAs? (sample these first)

blocks.zh: 哪些位置可以用在線儀表替代手動取樣？（均質雜質）
blocks.en: Which locations can use in-line instruments instead of manual sampling? (homogeneous impurities)

blocks.zh: 哪些位置存在特殊的微生物或化學污染風險？（熱點）
blocks.en: Which locations carry special microbial or chemical contamination risk? (hot spots)

blocks.zh: 人員能否安全、方便地在該位置取樣？（可及性）
blocks.en: Can personnel sample at the location safely and conveniently? (accessibility)

blocks.zh: 關鍵警告：取樣點可及性影響數據品質
blocks.en: Key warning: sample point accessibility affects data quality

blocks.zh: ISPE 直接指出：取樣點不可及會導致警戒/行動水準超出次數增加——因為人員在困難條件下取樣容易引入外部污染，造成假陽性。常見的可及性問題：
blocks.en: ISPE points out directly that inaccessible sample points lead to more alert/action level excursions, because personnel sampling under difficult conditions easily introduce external contamination, causing false positives. Common accessibility problems:

blocks.zh: 回流管道安裝在天花板或管道夾層中
blocks.en: Return piping installed in the ceiling or in an interstitial pipe space

blocks.zh: 取樣點被其他設備遮擋
blocks.en: Sample points blocked by other equipment

blocks.zh: 取樣點高度超過 1.8 公尺，需要梯子
blocks.en: Sample points higher than 1.8 meters, requiring a ladder

blocks.zh: 取樣廢水無法安全排放（直接滴在地板上）
blocks.en: Sampling waste water cannot be discharged safely (dripping directly onto the floor)

blocks.zh: 比喻：迴路設計像城市地鐵規劃
blocks.en: Analogy: loop design is like city metro planning

blocks.zh: WFI 迴路就像地鐵環線：每個站（POU）都需要監控，但終點站（最後一個 POU 和回流口）是最重要的——乘客（水分子）在整條線上累積了所有可能的污染。同樣道理，回流口的水質代表整條迴路的「最差情況」，是製程控制監控的首選位置。
blocks.en: A WFI loop is like a metro circle line: every station (POU) needs to be monitored, but the terminal station (the last POU and the loop return) is the most important, because the passengers (water molecules) have accumulated every possible contamination along the whole line. By the same logic, the water quality at the loop return represents the "worst case" for the whole loop and is the preferred location for process control monitoring.

blocks.zh: A WFI loop has 8 POUs, with POU-7 located 80 meters from the supply header and POU-8 only 5 meters from the return header. Which POU poses the highest microbial risk and why? Where should you install a process control sampling point? （哪個 POU 微生物風險最高？製程控制取樣點應設在哪裡？）
blocks.en: A WFI loop has 8 POUs, with POU-7 located 80 meters from the supply header and POU-8 only 5 meters from the return header. Which POU poses the highest microbial risk and why? Where should you install a process control sampling point?

blocks.zh: During design review, a validation engineer notices that all three return-loop sample valves are installed in a pipe rack 2.4 meters above the floor, accessible only by a ladder. What risks does ISPE warn about? What design change would you recommend? （回流管道取樣點安裝在 2.4 公尺高處，有什麼風險？建議如何改進？）
blocks.en: During design review, a validation engineer notices that all three return-loop sample valves are installed in a pipe rack 2.4 meters above the floor, accessible only by a ladder. What risks does ISPE warn about? What design change would you recommend?

blocks.zh: Your CDMO is adding a new sub-loop to serve a new suite. The sub-loop returns to the main loop return header. Where must you install a sample point, and what is its purpose? （新增子迴路連接主回流管，取樣點應設在哪裡？）
blocks.en: Your CDMO is adding a new sub-loop to serve a new suite. The sub-loop returns to the main loop return header. Where must you install a sample point, and what is its purpose?

blocks.zh: 迴路幾何與取樣策略的關聯
blocks.en: How loop geometry relates to sampling strategy

blocks.zh: WFI/PW 迴路的幾何設計直接決定取樣策略：
blocks.en: The geometric design of a WFI/PW loop directly determines the sampling strategy:

blocks.zh: 2.2.1–2.2.3: Source Water, Pretreatment & Primary Treatment | 水源、前處理與初步處理
blocks.en: 2.2.1–2.2.3: Source Water, Pretreatment & Primary Treatment

blocks.zh: Potable feed water requirements; unit operation monitoring; before/after sampling strategy | 飲用水標準；單元操作監控；前後取樣策略
blocks.en: Potable feed water requirements; unit operation monitoring; before/after sampling strategy

blocks.zh: 中文解析：從水源到純化系統的取樣邏輯
blocks.en: Commentary: sampling logic from source water to the purification system

blocks.zh: 水源水質的重要性
blocks.en: The importance of source water quality

blocks.zh: 純化水和注射用水系統的性能高度依賴進水水質。進水水質的季節性變化（如雨季帶入更多有機物、夏季氯化加重）會影響下游設備的負荷和性能。建議：
blocks.en: The performance of purified water and water for injection systems depends heavily on feed water quality. Seasonal changes in feed water quality (for example, more organics brought in by the rainy season, heavier chlorination in summer) affect the load and performance of downstream equipment. Recommendations:

blocks.zh: 每季對水源進行全項化學分析
blocks.en: Perform a full chemical analysis of the source water every quarter

blocks.zh: 監測氯殘留量（目標：0.2–0.5 mg/L）
blocks.en: Monitor residual chlorine (target: 0.2–0.5 mg/L)

blocks.zh: 建立進水水質的趨勢分析，作為純化系統預防性維護的觸發依據
blocks.en: Establish trend analysis of feed water quality as a trigger for preventive maintenance of the purification system

blocks.zh: 活性碳過濾器：微生物監控的特別關注點
blocks.en: Activated carbon filters: a special point of attention for microbial monitoring

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別指出活性碳床（Activated Carbon Filter）會促進微生物生長——這是反直覺的！活性碳雖然能去除氯（脫氯），但脫氯後的水失去了抑菌作用，加上碳床表面積巨大，是理想的生物膜生長環境。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically points out that an activated carbon bed (Activated Carbon Filter) can promote microbial growth — this is counterintuitive! Although activated carbon removes chlorine (dechlorination), the dechlorinated water loses its bacteriostatic effect, and the huge surface area of the carbon bed makes it an ideal environment for biofilm growth.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：活性碳床後的微生物取樣頻率應比其他前處理設備高；部分廠商選擇用臭氧或 UV 替代活性碳，以減少微生物風險。
blocks.en: Practical recommendation: the frequency of microbial sampling after the activated carbon bed should be higher than for other pretreatment equipment; some manufacturers choose ozone or UV instead of activated carbon to reduce microbial risk.

blocks.zh: 前後取樣的診斷價值
blocks.en: The diagnostic value of before/after sampling

blocks.zh: 在每個單元操作「前後」取樣的目的是建立各設備的性能基準（performance baseline）。
blocks.en: The purpose of sampling "before and after" each unit operation is to establish a performance baseline for each piece of equipment.

blocks.zh: 實例：RO 前後的電導率差異反映 RO 膜的去除效率（rejection rate）。若某次 RO 後電導率高於正常值，前後取樣數據可立即判斷是否為膜損壞所致（前後差異縮小），而非進水水質問題（前後差異比例不變）。
blocks.en: Example: the difference in conductivity before and after RO reflects the rejection rate of the RO membrane. If conductivity after RO is higher than normal on a given occasion, the before/after sampling data can immediately show whether it is caused by membrane damage (the before/after difference narrows) rather than a feed water quality problem (the before/after ratio is unchanged).

blocks.zh: CDMO 挑戰：多套純化設備的取樣點數量
blocks.en: CDMO challenge: the number of sample points with multiple purification trains

blocks.zh: 大型 CDMO 廠可能有 2–3 套 PW 純化系統和 2 套 WFI 蒸餾器，共用多個儲槽和配水迴路。取樣點數量可能超過 50 個。管理策略：
blocks.en: A large CDMO site may have 2–3 PW purification systems and 2 WFI stills, sharing several storage tanks and distribution loops. The number of sample points can exceed 50. Management strategy:

blocks.zh: 以在線儀表（TOC、導電率）覆蓋均質屬性
blocks.en: Cover homogeneous attributes with in-line instruments (TOC, conductivity)

blocks.zh: 僅在最高風險點保留手動取樣（碳床後、蒸餾器後、配水迴路回流）
blocks.en: Keep manual sampling only at the highest-risk points (after the carbon bed, after the still, loop return of the distribution loop)

blocks.zh: 以 LIMS 系統管理取樣排程和趨勢分析
blocks.en: Manage the sampling schedule and trend analysis with a LIMS

blocks.zh: A PW system uses: multimedia filter → softener → activated carbon filter → RO → CEDI. List all the sampling locations you would install and identify the primary attribute(s) to monitor at each. （列出所有取樣位置和各點的主要監控屬性。）
blocks.en: A PW system uses: multimedia filter → softener → activated carbon filter → RO → CEDI. List all the sampling locations you would install and identify the primary attribute(s) to monitor at each.

blocks.zh: Source water chlorine levels drop from 0.4 mg/L to 0.05 mg/L due to a municipal supply change. What impact might this have downstream, and what sampling action would you trigger? （進水餘氯從 0.4 降至 0.05 mg/L，下游可能有什麼影響？）
blocks.en: Source water chlorine levels drop from 0.4 mg/L to 0.05 mg/L due to a municipal supply change. What impact might this have downstream, and what sampling action would you trigger?

blocks.zh: Your WFI still produces water that passes conductivity but fails endotoxin (3.0 EU/mL vs. limit 0.25 EU/mL). Using before/after sampling logic, which equipment would you test first to locate the source? （WFI 蒸餾水導電率合格但內毒素超標，用前後取樣邏輯如何追溯污染源？）
blocks.en: Your WFI still produces water that passes conductivity but fails endotoxin (3.0 EU/mL vs. limit 0.25 EU/mL). Using before/after sampling logic, which equipment would you test first to locate the source?

blocks.zh: 2.2.4–2.2.6: Storage Tanks, Distribution Systems & Points of Use | 儲槽、配水系統與使用點
blocks.en: 2.2.4–2.2.6: Storage Tanks, Distribution Systems & Points of Use

blocks.zh: Tank sampling strategy; loop return worst-case; POU definition and sampling requirements | 儲槽取樣；迴路回流最差情況；POU 定義
blocks.en: Tank sampling strategy; loop return worst-case; POU definition and sampling requirements

blocks.zh: 中文解析：儲槽、配水迴路與 POU 的取樣策略
blocks.en: Commentary: sampling strategy for storage tanks, distribution loops and POUs

blocks.zh: 儲槽取樣：直接 vs 間接評估
blocks.en: Tank sampling: direct vs. indirect assessment

blocks.zh: 直接在儲槽上設取樣點（如槽側壁上的取樣閥）可以評估槽內生物膜狀況，但實際操作中風險較高（取樣時可能污染儲槽）。更常見且風險較低的替代方案是：通過監測入水、回流水和出水三個位置的水質，間接推斷儲槽對水質的影響。
blocks.en: Placing a sample point directly on the storage tank (such as a sample valve on the tank side wall) makes it possible to assess the biofilm condition inside the tank, but in practice the risk is higher (the tank may be contaminated during sampling). A more common and lower-risk alternative is to infer the effect of the tank on water quality indirectly, by monitoring the water quality at three locations: inlet, return and outlet.

blocks.zh: 迴路回流口：最差情況（Worst Case）的含義
blocks.en: Loop return: the meaning of worst case

blocks.zh: 「回流口是整個配水系統水質最差的位置」這一結論的邏輯：
blocks.en: The logic behind the conclusion that "the loop return is the location with the worst water quality in the whole distribution system":

blocks.zh: 水從儲槽出發，流過整條迴路，最後從回流口返回
blocks.en: Water leaves the tank, flows through the entire loop and finally returns from the loop return

blocks.zh: 沿途每個 POU、每個閥、每個管接頭都有機會引入微生物
blocks.en: Along the way, every POU, every valve and every pipe connection has a chance to introduce microorganisms

blocks.zh: 水在迴路中行走最長距離，累積了所有潛在污染
blocks.en: The water travels the longest distance in the loop and has accumulated all potential contamination

blocks.zh: 因此，回流口的製程控制取樣代表迴路整體狀況的最保守評估。如果回流口水質合格，迴路中間點幾乎必然合格（但 POU 因為有延伸管路，仍需獨立取樣）。
blocks.en: Therefore, process control sampling at the loop return gives the most conservative assessment of the overall condition of the loop. If the water quality at the loop return is acceptable, the points in the middle of the loop will almost certainly be acceptable as well (but POUs still need to be sampled independently because of their extended piping).

blocks.zh: POU 的正確定義：延伸管路的重要性
blocks.en: The correct definition of a POU: the importance of extended piping

blocks.zh: ISPE 對 POU 的定義容易被誤解。POU 不是配水系統上的閥門，而是「水實際被使用的末端位置」。
blocks.en: ISPE's definition of a POU is easily misunderstood. A POU is not a valve on the distribution system but "the end location where the water is actually used".

blocks.zh: 舉例：一個 WFI 閥後連接一段軟管，軟管連接一個熱交換器，最後進入配製槽。在這個案例中：
blocks.en: Example: a WFI valve is followed by a hose, the hose connects to a heat exchanger, and finally the water enters the formulation tank. In this case:

blocks.zh: POU = 配製槽入口（水實際使用的地方）
blocks.en: POU = the formulation tank inlet (where the water is actually used)

blocks.zh: QC 取樣點 = 盡可能接近配製槽入口，包含軟管和熱交換器
blocks.en: QC sample point = as close as possible to the formulation tank inlet, including the hose and heat exchanger

blocks.zh: PC 取樣點可以在 WFI 閥的上游取樣埠
blocks.en: The PC sample point can be the upstream sample port of the WFI valve

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：停用 POU 的管理
blocks.en: CDMO practice: managing decommissioned POUs

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，隨著客戶產品的變化，某些 POU 可能長期停用（如某條生產線停產）。ISPE 要求停用的 POU 必須 lock out / tag out 並妥善維護。實務上的最佳做法：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, as client products change, some POUs may be out of use for a long time (for example, when a production line is shut down). ISPE requires that unused POUs be locked out / tagged out and properly maintained. Best practice:

blocks.zh: 在 SOP 中定義停用 POU 的管理流程（關閉、排水、隔離）
blocks.en: Define the management process for unused POUs in an SOP (close, drain, isolate)

blocks.zh: 停用的支管應定期沖洗（如每週）或完全隔離拆除
blocks.en: Flush unused branch lines regularly (for example, weekly) or isolate and remove them completely

blocks.zh: 恢復使用前，必須先進行微生物和化學取樣確認
blocks.en: Before returning to use, microbial and chemical sampling must be performed first to confirm quality

blocks.zh: 熱交換器的壓差管理
blocks.en: Differential pressure management for heat exchangers

blocks.zh: 當配水系統中包含熱交換器（如溫度調節）時，ISPE 要求藥用水側的壓力應高於加熱/冷卻介質側，以防止非衛生側的冷凝水或冷卻水滲入藥用水。若無法確保壓差，應使用雙管板熱交換器（double tube sheet），並監測下游導電率/TOC 作為洩漏指標。
blocks.en: When the distribution system includes a heat exchanger (for example, for temperature control), ISPE requires that the pressure on the pharmaceutical water side be higher than that on the heating/cooling medium side, to prevent condensate or cooling water from the non-hygienic side from leaking into the pharmaceutical water. If the pressure differential cannot be assured, a double tube sheet heat exchanger should be used, and downstream conductivity/TOC should be monitored as a leak indicator.

blocks.zh: A WFI loop return sample consistently shows bioburden of 8 cfu/100 mL (Action Limit: 10 cfu/100 mL). Individual POU results are all <1 cfu/100 mL. What does this pattern suggest about where the contamination is coming from? （回流口菌計數接近行動水準但各 POU 均低，這說明污染源在哪裡？）
blocks.en: A WFI loop return sample consistently shows bioburden of 8 cfu/100 mL (Action Limit: 10 cfu/100 mL). Individual POU results are all <1 cfu/100 mL. What does this pattern suggest about where the contamination is coming from?

blocks.zh: A formulation POU connects to the WFI loop with: POU valve → 2m hose → 0.2 µm filter → formulation vessel. For a QC microbial sample, should you sample before or after the filter? What does ISPE say about sampling "as used"? （取樣點應在 0.2 µm 過濾器前還是後？ISPE 的「以使用方式取樣」原則如何應用？）
blocks.en: A formulation POU connects to the WFI loop with: POU valve → 2m hose → 0.2 µm filter → formulation vessel. For a QC microbial sample, should you sample before or after the filter? What does ISPE say about sampling "as used"?

blocks.zh: A production line POU has been inactive for 3 months (locked out). Manufacturing wants to restart it next week. What sampling protocol would you require before allowing it to be used for product contact water? （停用 3 個月的 POU 重新啟用前，需要執行哪些取樣確認？）
blocks.en: A production line POU has been inactive for 3 months (locked out). Manufacturing wants to restart it next week. What sampling protocol would you require before allowing it to be used for product contact water?

blocks.zh: 中文總結：本節核心要點
blocks.en: Commentary summary: key points of this section

blocks.zh: 水的五種角色 → 取樣方式必須模擬實際使用條件
blocks.en: Five roles of water → sampling must simulate actual conditions of use

blocks.zh: 化學（均質）雜質：可以用迴路回流口在線儀表替代 POU 手動取樣；微生物（非均質）雜質：必須每個 POU 手動取樣
blocks.en: Chemical (homogeneous) impurities: an in-line instrument at the loop return can replace manual POU sampling; microbial (heterogeneous) impurities: every POU must be sampled manually

blocks.zh: 系統中 99.9% 以上的細菌存在於生物膜中；浮游菌計數是滯後指標
blocks.en: More than 99.9% of the bacteria in a system live in biofilm; the planktonic count is a lagging indicator

blocks.zh: 取樣目的的五大類別：法規、共識標準、製程控制、品質控制、技術調查
blocks.en: Five categories of sampling purpose: regulatory, consensus standards, process control, quality control, technical/investigative

blocks.zh: 警戒水準 = μ+2σ；行動水準 = μ+3σ；兩者均必須低於藥典規格，留有緩衝
blocks.en: Alert Level = μ+2σ; Action Level = μ+3σ; both must be below the pharmacopoeial specification, leaving a buffer

blocks.zh: 品質控制取樣必須包含下游所有組件（軟管、熱交換器）才具代表性
blocks.en: Quality control sampling must include all downstream components (hoses, heat exchangers) to be representative

blocks.zh: 迴路回流口 = 製程控制最差情況；最遠端 POU = 微生物風險最高點
blocks.en: Loop return = process control worst case; the most remote POU = the point of highest microbial risk

blocks.zh: 每個子迴路在匯入主回流前必須設獨立取樣點
blocks.en: Every sub-loop must have its own sample point before it joins the main return

blocks.zh: 停用 POU 必須 lock out/tag out；重新啟用前需執行取樣確認
blocks.en: Unused POUs must be locked out/tagged out; sampling confirmation is required before they are returned to use

blocks.zh: CDMO 行動清單
blocks.en: CDMO Action List

blocks.zh: 在廠房設計的概念/詳細設計階段進行水取樣點的 RA
blocks.en: Perform an RA of water sample points at the conceptual/detailed design stage of the facility

blocks.zh: P&ID 中標注所有取樣點，並在現場確認可及性和廢水排放
blocks.en: Mark all sample points on the P&IDs, and confirm accessibility and waste water discharge on site

blocks.zh: 建立以使用方式為基礎的 QC 取樣 SOP，包含軟管、熱交換器等所有下游組件
blocks.en: Establish a QC sampling SOP based on actual use, including all downstream components such as hoses and heat exchangers

blocks.zh: 以 3–6 個月穩態數據統計設定 Alert/Action 水準
blocks.en: Set Alert/Action levels statistically from 3–6 months of steady-state data

blocks.zh: 在 LIMS 中建立趨勢警報，自動偵測多點同時超出警戒水準的情況
blocks.en: Set up trend alerts in the LIMS that automatically detect simultaneous alert level excursions at multiple points

blocks.zh: 制定停用 POU 管理程序，含重新啟用前的取樣要求
blocks.en: Establish a management procedure for unused POUs, including sampling requirements before return to use
